title: Visual infrastructure benchmark: topology and metrics
description: Six image-capable models each attempted three durable repairs across two visual infrastructure incidents: authoritative topology drift and an operational metrics regression.
observations: Kimi K3, Ox Alpha, and MiMo V2.5 completed all six durable repairs; Kimi was the fastest of the sweepers at a 1:44 median.
GPT-5.6 Luna posted the fastest overall median at 1:32 and completed five of six repairs.
Every model passed all three topology-drift attempts; all four scored failures occurred on the less explicit metrics-regression incident.
MiMo V2.5 completed all six repairs for $0.0237 in reported model cost, while Ox Alpha reported no model charge.
notes: This is the first visual benchmark release produced from the dedicated two-scenario replaybook-infra-visual manifest.
The prompt did not translate either authoritative image into text.
Gemini's provider protocol error followed meaningful inference and remains scored under the benchmark availability policy. Three other failures reached the 900-second agent deadline.
Known aggregate spend is partial because three timed-out trials did not report final usage.
reproduction_command: python integrations/host/run_host_matrix.py --benchmark ../replaybook-infra/benchmark-visual.toml --models moonshotai/kimi-k3 google/gemini-3.7-flash openai/gpt-5.6-luna openai/gpt-5.6-sol stealth/ox-alpha xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 --reasoning-efforts high --concurrency 2 --base-port 29000
